description: Replication Data for: A Multi-Period Topology and Design Optimization Approach for District Heating Networks is a data set deposited in KU Leuven RDR by its authors Yannick Wack (Associatie KU Leuven). A data-set containing the structure, input parameters, time series and optimization results of the heating networks used in the case studies of the paper "A Multi-Period Topology and Design Optimization Approach for District Heating Networks". This data can be used to replicate the results of the publication. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: Excel. Size stated: 277339. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
